locator.title: 7 фишек «Острова Мечты», которые сделают ваш отдых ярче
locator.lead: 7 секретов «Острова Мечты»: где искать крутые фото и экстремальные развлечения

nearest_text_before.text: 📸 Третья локация — смотровая площадка в зоне «Замка Снежной королевы». Поднимитесь на второй этаж по указателю «Театр Мечты», здесь вас ждут кадры среди тысячи блистающих огней декораций и аттракционов.

nearest_text_after.text: Теперь вы знаете «Остров Мечты» чуть лучше, чем большинство гостей. Осталось проверить все лично — и, может быть, найти что-то свое, о чем мы не написали.

image_reading: A high, wide view looks across a brightly lit indoor fantasy park, with a large red-and-white mushroom house in the foreground and themed streets receding behind it.
Small visitors are visible on the open paths; decorative lights and suspended ceiling lights provide natural subtle motion cues.
The frame is already an overview, so the animation should preserve the readable park layout and the central mushroom house.
analysis.article_context: Gallery image for the section on secret viewing platforms: it presents the park as a wide, photo-worthy panorama of themed zones and glowing attractions.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation conveys the rewarding, expansive view of Dream Island available from its lesser-known photo spots.
structured_intent.primary_action: Visitors continuously stroll through the themed park pathways.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The final frame still clearly shows the central mushroom house within the broad glowing park panorama.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The park remains a welcoming, magical panorama to be explored and photographed.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, foot traffic moves naturally through the foreground and central paths as the decorative lights shimmer gently. Use one very slow forward camera push toward the large mushroom house to reinforce the elevated overview. Near the end, the movement settles with the mushroom house and surrounding themed zones remaining fully readable in the glowing panorama.
models.positive_prompt: From the elevated viewpoint, visitors stroll steadily along the paths while the park lights softly twinkle. A very slow push-in centers the red-and-white mushroom house, ending with the full glowing park panorama still clearly visible.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, begin the continuous flow of guests immediately and keep it evenly paced across the paths. A restrained forward camera move draws attention from the lookout-like wide view to the mushroom house while retaining the broad layout. The motion eases into a stable final overview in which the bright themed park remains visible around the focal building.
models.positive_prompt: Visitors drift along the park paths as the decorative lights twinkle; make a gentle forward push toward the central mushroom house, ending on a clear glowing overview of the surrounding themed zones.

models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, animate a focused continuous moment: visitors move calmly through the open paths and the many existing lights give a soft twinkle. Make one compact, smooth forward camera move toward the mushroom house without losing the elevated panorama. Reach a settled final frame where the focal house and the glowing themed zones around it remain clearly visible.
models.positive_prompt: A gentle forward move toward the central mushroom house as visitors walk through the paths and park lights softly twinkle, ending with the glowing themed park still visible as a wide panorama.
